value.text:
To charge the Orion E4 from 20% to 80%, a total of 60% change in state of charge (SoC) is required. The usable capacity of the Orion E4 is 64 kWh, so the energy needed for this charge is calculated as follows:

Required battery energy = Usable capacity × Change in SoC  
= 64 kWh × 0.60 = 38.4 kWh.

Assuming a wall-to-battery efficiency of 90%, the grid energy required is:

Grid energy = Required battery energy / Efficiency  
= 38.4 kWh / 0.90 = 42.67 kWh.

At a sustained charging power of 11 kW, the time to charge is:

Time = Grid energy / Charging power  
= 42.67 kWh / 11 kW = 3.88 hours, approximately 3 hours and 53 minutes.
